t: Din berakot liqriat shema veim tzerikim kavvana
s: Din berakot liqriat shema veim tzerikim kavvana ubo h' seipim: beraka sheniyya nechlequ chakamim biptichatah, yesh omerim "ahaba rabba", veyesh omerim "ahabat olam ahabtanu ku'". Vehaggeonim hikriu lomar beshacharit "ahaba rabba" ubearbit "ahabat olam". Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Velamma en beraka zo potachat be"baruk"? Mippene shehi semuka le"yotzer or" veday lah be"baruk" shebb"yotzer or":

Habberakot enan meakkebot et qeriat shema, sheim qeraah belo birkoteha — yatza yede chobat qeriat shema, vechozer veqore habberakot belo qeriat shema, shebbirkot qeriat shema enan kebirkot shear mitzvot sheen mebarekin otan ella ober laasiyyatan, shehare eno mebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu liqrot et shema", ukemo shennitbaer besiman n"t. Veap al pi ken tob lachazor veliqrot qeriat shema im habberakot. Veim lo chazar veqara lo haqriat shema velo habberakot — yatza yede chobat qeriat shema, ben yachid sheasa ken ben tzibbur:

Seder habberakot enam meakkebot, sheim hiqdim sheniyya larishona — yatza yede chobat berakot. Veap al pi shehashsheniyya enah potachat be"baruk" vekol beraka sheen bah malkut — enah beraka, mikkol maqom kevan shenittaqna semuka lachabertah, ap kesheqqore otah bipne atzmah — en bah shem umalkut biptichatah:

Zekirat maamad har sinay umaaseh amaleq umaasseh miryam umaaseh haegel hen mitzvot aseh shel tora. Vegam zekirat shabbat yesh omerim shemmitzvatah bekol yom. Vetob lezokran etzel qeriat shema, shekkesheyyomar "ubanu bacharta" — yizkor mattan tora, "veqerabtanu" — lehar sinay, "leshimka haggadol" — maaseh amaleq, sheen hashshem shalem ad sheyyimmacheh zaro, "lehodot leka" — happeh lo nibra ella lehodot velo ledabber leshon hara, vezehu zekirat maaseh miryam, "uzekartem et kol mitzvot Hashem" — zo hi shabbat sheshshequla keneged kol hammitzvot, umaaseh haegel — yesh mi sheomer sheyyizkor kesheomer "(leyachedka) beahaba", velo keotah shaa sheasu et haegel shello haya beahaba im haqqadosh baruk hu:

Kol hammitzvot tzerikot kavvana latzet yede choba baasiyyat otah mitzva. Veim asaah belo kavvana latzet yede chobato ella kemitasseq bealma o lekavvana acheret velo leshem otah mitzva — lo yatza yede chobato min hattora. Veyesh omerim shemmitzvot en tzerikot kavvana, veap hammitasseq yatza bediabad. Vahalaka kassebara harishona. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemmitzvot shel tora, abal beshel dibre soperim — yesh omerim shehalaka sheen tzarik kavvana. Veyesh choleqin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"h. Uqeriat shema hi min hattora, utzerika kavvana ledibre hakkol. Veap lehaomerim sheapillu mitzvot shel tora en tzarik kavvana, mikkol maqom biqriat shema tzarik kavvanat halleb sheyyabin mah shehu omer bepiv, velo ameru sheeno tzarik kavvana ella bekavvana latzet yede choba, abal tzarik kavvanat hainyan, kelomar shello yeharher bidbarim acherim, kede sheyyeqabbel malkut shamayim behaskamat halleb. Veeno domeh lishar mitzvot shehen mitzvot asiyya, vekol sheasa mitzvatah ap al pi shello kivven lah — hare qiyyem mitzvat asiyyatah, ella sheen zeh min hammubchar, vekol shekken im kivven latzet ap al pi shehirher bah baemtza bidbarim acherim — yatza ledibre hakkol. Abal qeriat shema utepilla shehen qabbalat ol malkut shamayim o siddur shebachim — eno bedin sheyyihyeh lebabo poneh lidbarim acherim. Vekol zeh bepasuq rishon shel qeriat shema shehu "shema yisrael", shehu iqqar qabbalat malkut shamayim. Veken bibraka rishona shel tepilla. Abal mi"veahabta" veelak — en hakkavvana meakkebet bediabad. Vaapillu haya qore battora o maggiah happarashiyyot ellu beonat qeriat shema — yatza yede chobato, ap al pi shello nitkavven latzet yede chobato. Vehu shenitkavven bepasuq rishon (mippene sheiqqar qeriat shema enah ella pasuq rishon bilbad shehu min hattora, vehashshear shetiqqenu chakamim lo hitzriku kavvana ella lekattechilla, abal im qara hashshear belo kavvana — en tzarik lachazor veliqrot, ben sheqqara belo kavvana latzet ben shello bekavvanat hainyan. Veap lehaomerim sheap mitzvot shel dibre soperim tzerikim kavvana latzet, mikkol maqom biqriat shema kevan sheenah mitzvat asiyya ella qabbalat malkut shamayim veol mitzvot shehu dabar hattaluy bekavvanat hainyan, lepikak kevan shello hitzriku lachazor veliqrot mippene chesron kavvanat hainyan — lo hitzriku gam ken lachazor mippene chesron kavvana latzet, ki mah betza sheyyachazor ledabber beli leb, veday bemah shehitzrikuhu liqrot bekol yom, sheal yede ken yabo gam ken leqabbala balleb berob happeamim, shehare lekattechilla hitzriku kavvana, ella sheim era miqreh shello nitkavven — lo hitrichu lachazor. Abal lehaomerim shemmi"veahabta" veelak hu gam ken min hattora — tzarik kavvana latzet bekol mah shehu min hattora. Abal kavvanat hainyan day bepasuq rishon ledibre hakkol bediabad):
